== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
After her meeting with [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]], Egwene returns to the Kandori battlefield. She uses [[Vora's sa'angreal]] to hurl large, boulder-sized fireballs at [[Trolloc|Trollocs]]. She exits through a [[Gateways|gateway]] with [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]], [[Romanda Cassin|Romanda]], [[Leane Sharif|Leane]], [[Silviana Brehon|Silviana]], [[Raemassa]], and several [[Warder|Warders]] onto the hilltop she just cleared. 

The Trollocs scatter as the attack turns on them, but as more coordinated groups of Trollocs linked to a [[Myrddraal|Fade]] charge the hilltop, the group realizes they cannot hold their position. They retreat through a gateway back to their camp and notice that a Trolloc who stumbled through the gateway died. This surprises them and the lock away the information for possible use later. 

Egwene senses something is not right and sends Gawyn to tell the officers to pull back just before a gateway larger than any she has ever seen opens up before them. She sees an enormous army wearing strange clothes made of knee-length padded armor reinforced with chain. The army is accompanied by hundreds of female channelers with tattooed faces and stiff dresses of black silk. She tells her [[Aes Sedai]] to release the [[One Power]] so that they cannot be sensed, then dashes out of view. Romanda does not listen and begins to weave a gateway. She never gets the chance to finish as she is obliterated where she stands. The group scrambles through the camp and [[Lelaine Akashi|Lelaine]] says that the invaders are [[Shara]]n. She says accounts from [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]] before the [[Aiel War]] spoke of them and the new arrivals match the information given. 

Their command tent is assaulted with the One Power. Egwene and Gawyn react in time, but Egwene searches for signs of Lelaine and wonders if [[Siuan Sanche|Siuan]] or [[Gareth Bryne|Bryne]] were in there as well. Egwene and Gawyn take cover under a destroyed wagon, covered by Gawyn's Warder cloak. The pair hide for over an hour while the channelers and soldiers kill anyone that runs take the rest captive. Egwene laments at her Aes Sedai and the army falling before the Sharans, but silently resolves to stay strong and survive, though she also allows herself to be held by Gawyn. 

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Aviendha crawls across the ground with [[Rhuarc]] to her left and [[Shaen]] to her right, with [[Amys]] accompanying them. No one objected to the [[Wise One|Wise Ones]] joining the advanced scouts. As they crest a hill, they see a giant forge and fires dotting the landscape below, next to a poisoned black river. The forge is manned by [[Shadow-Forger|creatures]] that are neither dead nor alive, and they are surrounded by caged humans whose blood will be used to temper newly forged blades.  

The air is cold with air that smells like it came from a tomb. [[Rodel Ituralde]] catches up to them. The [[Aiel]] have agreed to follow a [[wetlander]] general, but it did not sit well with them. They discuss the need to create a distraction so that Rand can slip in to face the [[Dark One]]. They speculate on how long the duel will last, and realize it could last for hours or years. They agree to cover Rand's back as long as it is required of them. Ituralde says he will direct the Aiel to attack and destroy the forge and Ituralde's men will clear the pass.  

They return to Rand who is accompanied by [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] and [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]]. Aviendha describes what they saw and Rand tells her about his plan to kill the Dark One. She says the greatest victory is to take his enemy ''[[gai'shain]]'' and that he must always have honor, no matter what, so she suggests imprisoning the Dark One would be the proper path. Rand doesn't agree outright but he doesn't disagree either. 

Back through a gateway to their camp, Aviendha releases the One Power and walks with Rand to this tent as the others walk ahead. He tells her that the [[Dull dagger|dagger]] worked - the Dark One could not see him. He also tells her about the fake seals and how he is expecting the [[Forsaken]] to arrive once he begins to fight the Dark One. He tells Aviendha that he needs her to confront the Forsaken while he is fighting and she agrees. The two walk up to the tent where [[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min]] is with Nynaeve and Moiraine; [[Callandor]] rests on Moiraine's lap with Thom sitting beside her. Rand asks Min if she would go and keep an eye on Egwene and the [[Seanchan]], who he has sent to fight with her. She agrees but warns him against using Callandor in his fight, as does Nynaeve. He says he understands the risks but he must allow this trap to be sprung. 

With all in place, Rand finally announces that the next day he will invade [[Shayol Ghul]].
